hero.title: Watch better.
hero.description: Native playback, sharper controls, and a calmer place for your next watch.

features.performanceTitle: Your library, without the browser tax.
features.overviewDescription: AlphaFlix Desktop gives playback the room it needs: native performance, clean handoffs, and controls that stay out of the way.
features.playbackDescription: Smooth video with desktop-grade media handling.
features.performanceDescription: Less chrome. More focus. No tab juggling.
features.continuityDescription: Resume, browse, and switch sources without losing the moment.
features.ecosystemDescription: The desktop app is the core. Addons extend the edges, so your setup can stay personal without becoming complicated.
features.showcaseDescription: A focused desktop surface for discovery, playback, and everything around the story.

addonGuide.title: Build an addon without joining the app process.
addonGuide.description: An addon is a small HTTP service. Serve a manifest and the resources you need; AlphaFlix handles the rest.
addonGuide.manifestDescription: Metadata tells the app who your addon is, which resources it supports, and where its icon lives.
addonGuide.resourcesDescription: Implement only the endpoints your addon needs. Responses are JSON and can be written in any language.

resources.catalog: Rows of movies or series for discovery.
resources.meta: Movie or series metadata for a title.
resources.stream: Torrent, HLS, DASH, or direct file sources.

steps: Serve /manifest.json and your resource endpoints from a local or public HTTP(S) server.
Test each endpoint with curl and verify the JSON shape.
Paste the manifest URL into AlphaFlix Desktop > Addons.
addonGuide.advancedDescription: The Stremio Addon SDK is optional. Use it if you want routing and serialization helpers; it is not required by the protocol.
